sources.topic: Spinosin as an acid-jujube representative quality-marker candidate
sources.title: Research progress of quality control for the seed of Ziziphus jujuba var. spinosa (Bunge) Hu ex H.F. Chow (Suan-Zao-Ren) and its proprietary Chinese medicines
sources.access_basis: Official PubMed and publisher search-indexed bibliographic/abstract records; direct publisher open403 and PubMed open returned only site footer.
sources.short_excerpt: The jujuboside A, jujuboside B, and spinosin were revealed as the key Q-markers for SZS.
sources.source_content_license: Not verified; no full text copied. Bibliographic metadata and a short attributed abstract excerpt only.
sources.supported_claim_zh: 文献将斯皮诺素列为酸枣仁质量标志候选，支持选择其作为代表性成分开展机制探索。
sources.limitation_zh: 这不证明本研究855份样品的斯皮诺素含量或其来源差异，更不证明任何THz峰属于它。索引结果混入2025版药典表述；本台账不采用药典版本或含量阈值断言。

sources.topic: Solid-state low-frequency THz, hydrogen-bond networks and dispersion
sources.title: Terahertz Vibrations and Hydrogen-Bonded Networks in Crystals
sources.access_basis: Publisher indexed metadata/abstract and university researcher publication listing; direct publisher open429.
sources.short_excerpt: The THz spectroscopy enables the characterization of solid-state materials through the excitation of soft intramolecular vibrational modes, as well as intermolecular modes and hydrogen-bonding networks inherent to the molecular assembly in the solid state.
sources.source_content_license: Not independently verified in this lookup; a short attributed abstract excerpt only.
sources.supported_claim_zh: 固体THz响应可能同时包含柔软分子内振动、分子间运动与氢键网络；综述讨论色散和非谐性对谱带解释的作用。
sources.limitation_zh: 综述不是斯皮诺素专门研究，不能据此给出斯皮诺素模式位置、色散修正幅度或药材固体峰归属。

sources.topic: Condensed-phase collective molecular dynamics and THz interpretation
sources.title: Investigating the function and design of molecular materials through terahertz vibrational spectroscopy
sources.access_basis: University of Strathclyde institutional publication page directly opened and read; title, authors, year, journal and DOI present together. Publisher open redirected to inaccessible authentication.
sources.short_excerpt: Terahertz spectroscopy probes the low-frequency vibrational dynamics of atoms and molecules, usually in the condensed phase. These nuclear dynamics, which typically involve displacements of entire molecules, have been linked to bulk phenomena
sources.source_content_license: Institutional metadata/abstract page copyright noted; short attributed excerpt only, no publisher full text downloaded.
sources.supported_claim_zh: 凝聚态THz常涉及整个分子的位移与材料集体动力学，不能把单个孤立分子的谐振正常模式直接等同于药材固体响应。
sources.limitation_zh: 综述提供通用背景而非本项目峰位证据；孤立分子计算可能解释局部运动，却不包含周期晶格和完整药材基质。

sources.topic: Numerical integration-grid sensitivity for floppy low-frequency modes
sources.title: How Reliable Are Modern Density Functional Approximations to Simulate Vibrational Spectroscopies?
sources.journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
sources.access_basis: Official PubMed/publisher/PMC indexed metadata and abstract; direct ACS open403 and PMC open reCAPTCHA.
sources.short_excerpt: We show that properties of molecules with low-frequency modes calculated with density functional approximations (DFAs) suffer from spurious oscillations along the nuclear displacement coordinate due to numerical integration errors.
sources.source_content_license: ACS indexed record explicitly identifies CC BY4.0; direct full text not read or downloaded.
sources.supported_claim_zh: 柔软低频模式的数值导数可能受积分网格影响，应做网格与收敛敏感性检查，并保留虚频和小频率的不确定性。
sources.limitation_zh: 文章研究特定DFAs和分子；它不提供本项目PBE/grid1或斯皮诺素的误差上界，也不意味着应直接改用其中某个泛函。

sources.topic: An experimental solid-state example where dispersion matters for THz modeling
sources.title: Noncovalent Interactions in Paired DNA Nucleobases Investigated by Terahertz Spectroscopy and Solid-State Density Functional Theory
sources.journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry A
sources.access_basis: Official PubMed indexed abstract, publisher indexed article and issue table of contents; direct ACS open403.
sources.short_excerpt: these weak dispersion forces in the adenine-thymine cocrystal were necessary to produce a properly converged crystal structure and meaningful simulation of the terahertz vibrational spectrum.
sources.source_content_license: Not verified; short attributed abstract excerpt only, no paywalled full text downloaded.
sources.supported_claim_zh: 有具体分子晶体案例显示色散处理会影响结构与THz谱模拟，支持如实标记当前PBE无D3并保留方法敏感性验证。
sources.limitation_zh: 案例是核碱基共晶，不是斯皮诺素。不能外推其频率修正数值、误差方向或要求把某种晶体方法原样用于孤立斯皮诺素。
